audit.whatIsWrong: Row 1 read Singed while whys[1] says 'Level 2 stays even; without Fling Singed can't turn a trade', and row 6 read Singed while whys[6] says 'Late game evens'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Singed, Skill, Skill, Singed, Skill] and the mirror audit records the identical chart, so both directions already agree.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 6 flipped to Skill in both layers as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Singed's spikes were described without a single number, and the level-3 spike was credited to 'Fling plus poison trail' when the ability that actually changes the lane at 3 is Mega Adhesive.
audit.why: Kit: Mega Adhesive (W) 17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range, grounding. Fling (E) 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, 125 range. Insanity Potion (R) 100s flat, applies Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail. Poison Trail (Q) has no cooldown at all — it is a toggle, so 'wait for his Q' is never advice.
audit.corrected: Mega Adhesive at 17s named as the level-3 spike, Fling given 10s and its 125 range, Insanity Potion given 100s and its anti-heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup's decisive interaction was never on the page: Mega Adhesive GROUNDS. Standing in it you cannot Nimbus Strike in or dash out with Warrior Trickster — and a Fling that lands you inside the goo ROOTS instead of only knocking up. The page's whole 'decoy his fling' plan ignores that his W turns both of your mobility spells off.
audit.why: Riot text — W: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.' E: 'flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' R: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.'
audit.corrected: Written into the level-3 phase, the cooldown block, the Do's, the Don'ts, the report and the 3-5 spike: never dash while you are standing in the goo, and expect a root if he flings you into it.

edits.before: W clone bails out any misstep and baits his answer. Only take the trade when Singed's Fling is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is even — Fling is 10s at rank 1 and 125 range, so he has to touch you to turn a trade.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Singed must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds: stand in the goo and you cannot Nimbus Strike in or clone out. It is 17s at rank 1 — wait it out.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Mega Adhesive: 17s at rank 1 — it grounds, so never dash while standing in it. - Fling: 10s at rank 1, 125 range; flung into the goo you are rooted. - Insanity Potion: 100s of Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling before you commit
edits.after: Never dash while you stand in his goo

edits.before: His flip. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds — no Nimbus Strike, no clone out.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A Fling that lands you in Mega Adhesive roots you outright.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds your dashes; Fling into it roots you. Wait, then E-Q.

edits.before: Once Singed has his Fling (E) plus poison trail he flips the proxy game — if you chase him through his gas you take stacking DoT and get Flung into your own minions. E-Nimbus onto him only when his Fling is down, land Q, and disengage before you eat the trail.
edits.after: Once Singed has Fling (E) plus poison trail he flips the proxy game — chase him through the gas and you take stacking DoT, then get Flung into your own minions. Mega Adhesive (W) grounds, so never Nimbus Strike or clone while you stand in it.

edits.before: Singed doesn't spike at 6 the way you might — his Insanity Potion (R) is a sustained stat boost, not a burst window, so your Cyclone all-in is actually cleaner here. Catch him off his gas with W-decoy into R and you can kill through his ghost.
edits.after: Singed doesn't spike at 6 the way you might — his Insanity Potion (R) is a 100s stat boost whose poison applies Grievous Wounds, so your Cyclone all-in is actually cleaner here. Catch him off his gas with W-decoy into R and you can kill through his ghost.

notes: Poison Trail has cd 0 and costs 13 mana per tick — it is a toggle, so any 'wait for his Q cooldown' advice would be false; none was added. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds is now stated, which is what justifies the page's existing Executioner's Calling line — before this edit the item recommendation had no reason attached. Mega Adhesive is also a projectile-flagged throw at 1000 range, but Riot's text describes a thrown vial creating ground, so I did not write any Wind Wall-class claim.
